text:
maria-sec: Quick proposal — shrink dev SIEM retention from 90d to 14d to cut costs.
jon-ops: big if. How do we handle investigations that need older dev traces?
kate-sre: we can keep prod at 365d and schedule encrypted exports for long-term archive. dev exports disabled by default.
maria-sec: exactly. Sketch: prod -> SIEM 365d live; nightly exports to s3://secure-logs with CMK. dev -> 14d, but allow `retain_for_investigation` tag to opt-in per-case.
mike-infra: tagging + export pipeline ok. Need clear RBAC: only security:forensics or legal:ediscovery can set retain tag or request exports.
ana? (typo note: original is "ana-legal")
ana-legal: (Ana) legal wants a mandatory request ticket with justification and audit trail attached to export metadata.
jon-ops: can we gate requests via Jira + OPA? oncall-bot: please attach approval-policy
kate-sre: automation: if request contains incident_id then auto-approve for security team; otherwise manual security lead approval.
maria-sec: KMS question: when we rotate CMKs will we still decrypt old exports?
mike-infra: yes if we retain previous key versions and include a key policy allowing the service principal decrypt. We'll also document a rewrap process for edge cases.
jon-ops: I'll write an OPA policy — conditions: requester department, presence of incident tag, legal_hold flag, and deny if retention_days > 365 without explicit approval.
kate-sre: RBAC role split proposal: `export:request`, `export:approve` (security lead), `export:retrieve` (forensics & legal). Minimizes blast radius.
maria-sec: we also need integrity verification on exports. Recommend HMAC + manifest stored alongside the object. Example manifest below (store as UTF-8 json blob):
```
{
  "export_id": "exp-2026-09-21-42",
  "timestamp": "2026-09-21T04:12:00Z",
  "case_id": "CASE-2026-198",
  "origin": "prod-usw2",
  "retention_days": "365",
  "legal_hold": "false",
  "hmac": "sha256:...",
  "manifest_checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```
mike-infra: sample upload command (enforced server-side encryption):
```
aws s3 cp /tmp/export.tgz s3://secure-logs/2026-09-21/exp-42.tgz --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01
```
jon-ops: also add a manifest signing step and include the signing public key in a key registry.
ana-legal: legal requirements: audit metadata must include `requestor`, `approver`, `jira_ticket`, `justification`; default `legal_hold=false`. Keep audit trail for 7 years.
kate-sre: we'll add a validation job that checks every export has a manifest + HMAC and that the object path matches manifest.export_id.
maria-sec: action items: (1) infra IAM PR with role defs + CMK policy (mike), (2) OPA policy + Jira workflow (jon), (3) export job template, manifest schema, and validation job (kate), (4) legal metadata schema + retention (ana), (5) KMS rotation runbook and rewrap steps (mike). I'll draft RFC and link here.
mike-infra: opening infra-iam PR today.
jon-ops: drafting OPA rego and Jira automation, will tag security for review.
ana-legal: OK pending explicit Jira justification + audit trail fields.
oncall-bot: reminder: infra deploy window 2026-09-24 02:00-04:00 UTC.
maria-sec: thanks all — target to land these changes by end of week. :thumbsup:
